verdict.rationale: Lovable is built around natural-language operation: users describe apps in chat, and Lovable generates them, creates schemas, adds auth, and accepts mid-task steering. Project actions such as publishing, deploying and finding a domain can also be run from chat, and the same prompting works through Slack and via its MCP server. Community users corroborate prompt-driven building (scaffolding, internal tools, prototypes), though output quality is mixed. Missing for 10: evidence that administrative operations like credits and workspace settings are chat-operable (they are documented as UI paths), and independent hands-on corroboration of chat-triggered publish and domain actions.
